page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Three left-margin notes: an upper note beside "spem ullam revivifcendi" (mark *), a middle note beside "perditio creaturæ" (mark †), and a lower note beside "ejus potentia" (mark *). Printed page number at the top left, running head at the top centre, catchword at the bottom right.

At non abolitio seu in nihilum redactio [?]

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "dignitate" at the start of the page is read from a damaged first letter; the Greek word ὄλεθρον is uncertain in its accents. The left-margin note after "†" ("At non abolitio seu in nihilum redactio") is partly unclear in its middle words, which are marked [?]. The lower note "At æterni- tas illa pœna non tam apo- tentia Dei pendet" is partly blurred. Paragraph division within the page is uncertain: the text may contain breaks that are hard to see at the line ends, and I have kept it as one paragraph. The star reference marks appear twice on the page; the top one attaches to "revivifcendi" and the lower one to "potentia". The word "Thef." is printed as such. Right-edge letters are cut off by the scan.
